items.title: Bitcoin circles $81.5K ETF cost basis as Trump Iran comments send stocks lower
items.summary: Bitcoin extended daily losses to 3% as US stocks came under pressure from President Donald Trump’s comments on Iran military action.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF buyers are trend followers, not setters, DWF Labs says
items.summary: DWF Labs research finds that Bitcoin ETF flows follow past BTC price movements rather than predict future returns, with investors buying rallies and selling dips.

items.title: Crypto traders seek shelter in bitcoin as altcoins slide and ETF flows wobble
Bitcoin ETFs draw $528 million as ether funds snap five-day outflow streak
items.summary: Spot bitcoin ETFs attracted $528 million on Wednesday as BlackRock and Fidelity led a recovery in institutional demand.
